title: Round 1 fixes adequate for maintainer burden
description: All P1 maintainer concerns from round 1 addressed: hyper pin comment (KITH-626.1), handshake stability (KITH-626.2), size constant security rationale (KITH-626.6), socket cleanup via SocketGuard RAII (KITH-626.24), null-byte security comment (KITH-626.26). No new P1 concerns found. Remaining open items (KITH-626.10 error message styles, P3/P4 dead code) are opinion-rated and do not represent maintainer traps.
